comments.comment: I lost the use of my left thumb for half a year due to De Quervain's tenosynovitis following childbirth. No one should be forced to birth a child for adopters with all the risks that come with pregnancy.

Moreover, the crisis is almost always temporary.

There is no industry set up to help a mother deemed to be unworthy. Multi billion dollar adoption industry is fueled by intended parents, classism and misogyny: it’s always ready to help their customers to someone else’s offspring.
Being pregnant when you don't want to be is also unnecessary trauma.

Believing that a woman who voluntarily chose to be a surrogate for a couple that paid her medical bills is “exploited” but that a teenage who was forced to carry a pregnancy without any medical emotional or financial support and then give the baby up for adoption is not peak cognitive dissonance.
Luckily, there is Let Them Live, which empowers mothers to cancel abortion appointments, while supporting employment, housing, educational needs to make keeping their babies easier.
